content.text: For example, when we were kids, you would say, oh, my dog ate my homework.
content.trans: 比如我们小时候，你会说：噢，我的狗把我的作业吃了。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: But that really happened to me once.
content.trans: 但这种事真的在我身上发生过一次。

content.text: Your dog ate your homework?
content.trans: 你的狗吃了你的作业？

content.text: My cat ate my homework.
content.trans: 是我的猫吃了我的作业。

content.text: Your cat ate your homework.
content.trans: 你的猫吃了你的作业。

content.text: And what did your teacher say?
content.trans: 那你的老师怎么说？

content.text: Well, actually, I was a really good student, so my teacher believed me.
content.trans: 额，其实我是个很好的学生，所以老师相信了我。

content.text: Well, my teacher wouldn't have believed me.
content.trans: 好吧，我的老师肯定不会相信我。

content.text: Really?
content.trans: 真的吗？

content.text: No, no, she would have called my parents most likely.
content.trans: 不不，她很可能会打电话给我父母。

content.text: My cat really did eat my homework.
content.trans: 我的猫真的把作业吃了。

content.text: And I just left it on the table and it chewed it all up.
content.trans: 我把它留在桌子上，它把它嚼碎了。

content.text: That's weird.
content.trans: 太奇怪了。

content.text: Why would your cat do that?
content.trans: 你的猫为什么要那样做？

content.text: I don't know.
content.trans: 我也不知道。

content.text: A lot of weird excuses out there.
content.trans: 外面有很多稀奇古怪的借口。

content.text: I was abducted by aliens.
content.trans: “我被外星人绑架了。”

content.text: My mom accidentally mailed my homework to Africa.
content.trans: “我妈妈不小心把我的作业邮寄到了非洲。”

content.text: Really?
content.trans: 真的？

content.text: Does this happen to you?
content.trans: 这发生在你身上过吗？

content.text: Creative writing.
content.trans: 创意写作（脑洞大开）。

content.text: Creative excuses.
content.trans: 有创意的借口。

content.text: Well, I want to hear from our listeners.
content.trans: 好了，我想听听听众的想法。

content.text: I want to know what excuses they've used for being late with something.
content.trans: 我想知道他们曾用过什么借口来解释迟交某物。

content.text: So send us your excuses.
content.trans: 把你们的借口发给我们吧。

content.text: Send us your comments and questions.
content.trans: 也发送你们的评论和问题。

content.text: Go to our website at englishpod.com where Eric and I are always there to answer your questions.
content.trans: 访问我们的网站 englishpod.com，我和 Erica 随时准备回答您的问题。

content.text: That's right, Marco.
content.trans: 没错，Marco。

content.text: And this is an elementary lesson, right?
content.trans: 这是初级课程，对吧？

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: But we also have intermediate and upper intermediate and advanced lessons for you more fluent English
content.trans: 但我们也有中级、中高级和高级课程，适合更流利的

content.text: speakers.
content.trans: 英语使用者。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正是。

content.text: So if you're listening to us on iTunes, be sure to visit our website and come see what
content.trans: 所以如果你在 iTunes 上收听，一定要访问我们的网站，看看

content.text: else we have to offer.
content.trans: 我们还能提供些什么。

content.text: Well, I think we're out of time.
content.trans: 好了，我想我们的时间到了。

content.text: But until next time, it's goodbye.
content.trans: 下次见，再见。
